description: Request a site survey or callback. Attach quoteRef. Use when the person explicitly asks to be contacted and has supplied name and email or phone; it sends a real email. 3 per IP and 2 per email per day. (REST: POST /api/agent/v0/contact)

idempotencyKey.description: Sent as the Idempotency-Key header (retry safely)

quoteRef.description: Optional: the quoteRef from get_quote / unifi_estimate (valid 24 h). Attaches that estimate to the request.
